Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients (men and nonpregnant women) with systemic hypertension and patients with hypercholesterolemia will be included for this study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a male with hypercholesterolemia (LDL >190 mg/dL and genetic confirmation of familial hypercholesterolemia).

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Must be capable of rendering informed consent for all procedures.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient with aspirin allergies and those with a platelet count less than 50,000 will be excluded.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of aspirin allergy or platelet count in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Volunteers cannot be in any kind of medication while participating in this study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently on metformin for diabetes mellitus type 2.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: No history of diabetes, peripheral vascular disease, coagulopathy, or vasculitis.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a documented history of diabetes mellitus type 2.

Recap: Patient meets inclusion criteria for hypercholesterolemia and consent capability but is excluded due to diabetes and ongoing metformin use.
